title: Get welcome messages within an ad account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the welcome messages within the welcome message library of your ad account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | auto_message_type {Required} | string | The type of automatic message to greet people with when they start a conversation with you.

Enum value:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to welcome people to the conversation after they tap on your ad.
| | auto_message_id | string | The ID of the automatic message.

When `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`, you can specify the ID of a welcome message via this field to filter the results.

If this field is not passed, all messages that belong to the specified automatic message type will be returned. | | page | number | Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1. | | page_size| number | Page size.

Value range: 1-100.
Default value: 10. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&auto_message_type=WELCOME_MESSAGE&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| list | object[] | The list of automatic messages within the ad account. | ##| auto_message_id | string | The ID of the automatic message. | ##| auto_message_type | string |The type of automatic message to greet people with when they start a conversation with you.

Enum value:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to welcome people to the conversation after they tap on your ad.
| ##| welcome_message | string | Information about the welcome message. | ###| title | string | The name of the welcome message.

You can use the name to distinguish between different welcome messages within the welcome message library of your ad account. | ###| content | string | The greeting within the welcome message.

Example: `Hi, thanks for contacting us. How can we help you?` | ###| suggested_questions | object[] | A list of suggested questions for customers to tap.
A suggested question is a frequently asked question displayed at the beginning of a chat. When the user selects a suggested question, the user will automatically receive the corresponding preset answer.Suggested questions. | ####| question | string | A frequently asked question to help users start a conversation. | ####| answer | string | The preset answer that will be automatically sent when a user selects the question. | ##| audit_status| string | The review status of the automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `AUDITING`: The automatic message is pending review.
  • `PASS`: The automatic message has been approved.
  • `REJECTED`: The automatic message has been rejected.
| ##| create_time | string | The time when the automatic message was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. | #| page_info | object | Pagination information.

Note: If `auto_message_id` is specified in the request, `page_info` will not be returned. | ##| page | number | Current page number. | ##| page_size | number | Page size. | ##| total_number | number | Total number of results. | ##| total_page | number | Total pages of results. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auto_message_list": [ { "audit_status": "PASS", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "auto_message_type": "WELCOME_MESSAGE", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "welcome_message": { "content": "{{content}}", "suggested_questions": [ { "answer": "{{answer}}", "question": "{{question}}" }, { "answer": "{{answer}}", "question": "{{question}}" }, { "answer": "{{answer}}", "question": "{{question}}" } ], "title": "{{title}}" } } ] } } (/code) ```
